item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: I'd like some help with how I come across in this pic. I've been feeling a little unsure about whether it gives the right impression. What I'm hoping you can do is make me, the man in the photo, look professional. I always find it surprisingly hard to judge my own photos.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t complete the edit because Magic Hour reported insufficient credits. No edited image was created.

Your direct eye contact already works well for a professional portrait. The casual impression comes mainly from the T-shirt and kitchen background—not from you. I’d suggest a navy blazer, a light blue shirt, a neutral background, and softer, balanced lighting while keeping your features natural.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit this photo into a natural, polished professional headshot of the same man. Preserve his recognizable identity, age, facial structure, gray hair, stubble, and natural skin texture. Replace the casual gray T-shirt with a well-fitted navy blazer over a light blue open-collar business shirt. Replace the kitchen with a simple neutral gray studio background. Balance the lighting for soft, flattering, professional illumination and natural skin tones. Keep his direct gaze and authentic expression, with a relaxed, approachable professional presence. Maintain the square head-and-shoulders composition. Photorealistic, understated retouching, no text.
